context: Riku and Sho hang out after school; teen friendship banter about a new game.
purpose: Teen-to-teen casual gaming chat with playful energy.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: このゲーム、めっちゃ難しい!
lines.style: Bright, energetic frustration. Quick attack on the opening. Animated — almost bouncing in the chair. Lean into the complaint without self-pity.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Soft, genuinely curious. No condescension — just interest in the problem. Slight tilt forward, meeting him where he is. Warm attentiveness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.en: The boss fight — I can't beat it.
lines.style: Honest frustration without drama. Quiet acceptance of defeat. Pause before the dash — a moment of admitting the struggle. Vulnerable but steady.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I'll show you how to beat it.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. No boasting — just a simple offer of knowledge. Slight lift in the voice on 「コツ」 equivalent: he knows something useful. Generous.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Immediate, genuine relief. Bright tone lifts on the first word. Gratitude that's natural, not overdone. Quick pace — he's eager to listen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Easy, offhand delivery. No swagger — just matter-of-fact. Slight smile in the tone. Casual confidence that comes from knowing something well.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Warm, genuine admiration underneath. Quiet — not a performance. Slow pace, letting the words land. The kind of thing he might not often say, so it carries weight.
